title: Seller's Property Condition Disclosure Form
description: Idaho Code §55-2508 requires sellers of residential real property to provide a completed Property Condition Disclosure Form to the buyer. The form covers structural, mechanical, environmental conditions, and known defects. Idaho follows a caveat emptor tradition but the statutory disclosure form creates affirmative disclosure obligations for items covered on the form. Certain transfers are exempt under §55-2506.

required_actions.note: Must be delivered to buyer before acceptance of the purchase offer. Exemptions exist for foreclosures, court-ordered transfers, and new construction with builder warranty.

title: Brokerage Representation Disclosure
description: Idaho Code §54-2085 requires licensees to provide the Brokerage Representation brochure to potential clients and customers at the first substantial contact. Idaho recognizes buyer's agents, seller's agents, dual agents, and nonrepresentation (limited dual agency). Written consent is required for dual agency.

required_actions.note: Brokerage Representation brochure must be provided at first substantial contact. Dual agency requires written informed consent.

title: Title Company/Escrow Closing State
description: Idaho is a title company/escrow closing state. Closings are conducted through title companies or escrow agents. Attorney presence is not required. Title insurance is standard practice for residential transactions.

required_actions.note: Title companies handle closings. Attorney not required but recommended for complex transactions.

title: Well Water and Water Rights Disclosure
description: Idaho's property disclosure form requires sellers to disclose the water source (municipal, well, shared well, spring). For properties with well water, Idaho Code §42-226 establishes the doctrine of prior appropriation for water rights. Sellers must disclose water right permit numbers, whether rights are currently in good standing with IDWR, and any known water quality issues.

required_actions.note: Disclose water source, water right permit numbers, and status with Idaho Department of Water Resources (IDWR).

title: Mold Disclosure Requirement
description: Idaho's property condition disclosure form (Idaho Code §55-2508) specifically includes mold as a required disclosure item. Sellers must disclose known presence of mold or mold conditions, previous mold remediation, and any moisture intrusion issues that could lead to mold growth.

required_actions.note: Seller must disclose known mold, prior mold remediation, and moisture intrusion conditions on the statutory disclosure form.
